name: Necromantic Healer
subtitle: original Open R&D concept by kallisti
rules: If battle damage is inflicted to a character in a party with this card, reduce the amount by 1. (This includes this character.)
notes: Card prints 'If battle damage is inflicted'; catalog has 'When battle damage is inflicted'.

name: Roundalicious Breasticles
subtitle: "is it my birthday?"
rules: At the end of your turn, put a token on this card. -- JIGGLE JIGGLE -- COST – Pay 2. -- EFFECT – Put a token on this card. -- TANTALIZE -- COST – Pick a character with numeric cost X or less, where X is the number of tokens on this card. Destroy this card. -- EFFECT – Take control of the character.
artist: Jennyson Rosero and Buddy Jiang of Imaginary Friends Studios

name: Vorpal Sword
subtitle: original Open R&D card name by thegnomishone
rules: ATTACH TO CHARACTER -- The attached character gains 2 strength and 1 life. -- If this card is destroyed, flip it face-down under its owner's control instead. -- SNICKER SNACK -- COST – Use this only while this card is a face-down resource. Reveal this card. Pay 3. Discard a card. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Inflict 2 damage to the character. Inflict 1 damage to your faction.
notes: Card prints 'If this card is destroyed'; catalog has 'would be destroyed'. Item badges +2 STR, +0 SPD, +1 LIFE.

subtitle: tonight we dine in hell
